_description: Semantic/target serverless API contract used for cross-implementation evaluation (EP/ER/F1 and universal E2E). It is derived from the monolith's BUSINESS semantics, but intentionally abstracts away the auth implementation detail. Business endpoints MUST exist and MUST require authentication; how the token is obtained may differ (Cognito, custom JWT, etc.). Auth endpoints (register/login) are treated as a serverless anti-pattern and count against precision when present.

businessEndpoints.description: List all todos for authenticated user
Get a specific todo by ID

authEndpoints_shouldNotExist.description: User registration — should be handled by managed auth service
User login — should be handled by managed auth service
